note: Frederick County VA publishes its zoning layer (current, proposed and agricultural districts) only as shapefile/geodatabase files under a copyright agreement via its digital planimetric data order. Its ArcGIS server (fredcogis.fcva.us) has no public REST services directory (404 at /arcgis/rest/services and /maps/arcgis/rest/services), and its viewer is a web app with no service URL exposed. The gis.frederickco.gov Zoning layer found in search is Frederick County, Colorado, not Virginia. Winchester (independent city, not in the county) and Middletown/Stephens City zoning are not queryable services.
